items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: I saw this cat, Peg ? , man, he was a Rembrandt picture.

ctx.x: You see, when I went to school one of the main things my teacher, German lady, insisted on, now, a lot of you are going to be professional musicians. She'd say, "Well, let me tell you something." She's a German lady. "She'd say, appearance is half the battle. Always look good. If you look good and can play good, you can't miss."

What did she say that for, man. I became a clothes horse, you know. I was dressing sharp. That's one reason why I became a drummer. I saw this cat, Peg ? , man, he was a Rembrandt picture. He was tall and elegant. I said, "Man, I'd like to look like that." That was sharp as -- oeee, he was a gasser! I never seen -- sharp on the stage, off the stage. This cat, I said, yeah, that's it. I'm going to be like that one day, I'm going to be like that. And that was it.
So then when you all got the band together, it was like you and Ellington got guys to start being as conscious of --
